Dome height max0.22m over mud, not rock boulders; smooth coherent mud material. Rim height varies0.45–0.68m with slumped front-right sector0.32m, mud surface0.26m. Real integrated radial basin and opaque shallow mud; cup depression and low lip sculpted rather than black painted disc. Concept excessive tiny noise omitted; no detached splashes, steam billboard or tall geyser. Full underside closed.
